source_snapshot.scope: Only .py text, copied byte-for-byte. No weights, meshes, training arrays or dataset files.
source_snapshot.diff_scope: Added files under r2/pilots/seam_hinge_quality_v1 only. Git read-only ls-files guard; no git index/worktree mutation.
source_snapshot.limits: Dependency inclusion follows actual registration source hash records, not speculative transitive imports. New current-only helpers are labelled separately.

scope: Read-only existing 84 saved endpoint cells: 28 PLAIN_S2000 POST +28 HINGE015 +28 HINGE025. No mesh rescoring, model call, new noise, or geometry change.
policy: 35-family persistent dictionary is a policy/catalog, NOT an implemented 35-family suite. 124 original numeric fields include multiple thresholds, numerators/denominators, counts and diagnostics; 11 separately versioned graph fields are additional.
scale_definition: Fixed canonical cube diagonal sqrt(3)*2/.3762, not output bbox and not source GT bbox
boundary_aggregation: Within-output VMR is matched C-boundary vertices / all registered nonempty C-boundary vertices; A-VMR is mean VMR. Within-output perfect is boolean; PMR is mean perfect. 4 fixed noises per C, so equal-output and equal-parent means agree for this balanced complete panel.
I_definition: I = weighted coverage on frozen C2048 of (cross OR dup), divided by full C-query weight. cross: distance<0.005L to a verified proper CF intersection segment belonging to the query C face. dup: C-interior query (border distance>=0.01L), within<0.005L of any finite nondegenerate free triangle with |normal dot|>=cos15deg. A tolerance-band proxy, not whole-mesh intersection volume or proof of redundant layers.
I_denominator: Sum of all frozen 2048 C-query weights = 1.0, including boundary-near queries; not only the interior subset.
I_support: All 84 I statuses PASS; no unresolved/degenerate pair or unknown sampled coverage in these caches. This is detector-specific, not a formal exact-arithmetic certificate.
CF_FF_definition: Two separately retained illegal classes: proper_transverse_penetration and coplanar_positive_area_overlap. Main percentages use number of distinct free participants / actual retained free count. Pair counts and full tested-pair denominators are independent fields.
exact_index_distinction: EXACT_COORD reconstructs hypothetical coordinate-welded identity (FP32 bits); graph/topology uses actual saved faces indices. RAW_SOUP fields are counterfactual soup formulas even in POST rows. None should be silently substituted for another.
legal_graph_definition: Actual saved-index edge exactly 2 incidents, positive length/area, neither face an actual-index duplicate, and legal verified pair classification. Legal class set includes shared_edge_contact, shared_vertex_contact, coplanar_boundary_or_tolerance_contact, noncoplanar_edge_or_tangent_contact, point_or_tangent_contact. Actual shared-edge topology remains prerequisite. Winding opposition additionally required only for separately named opposed fields.
raw_inheritance: Both HINGE variants are deterministic CPU transforms of the same saved S2000 POST; reuse the same RAW, C, N, source IDs, D0 and frozen queries. RAW metrics/RAW adoption are one common reference, not three independent samples; HINGE must not claim improved RAW adoption.

not_applicable.reason: Open-ended C-conditioned generation; source style not unique correct output.
All-C boundary matching is descriptive; no required closure boundary contract registered.

not_implemented_or_not_run.reason: No such implemented/executed values in these 124+11 fields; requires additional datasets/features/budgets.
I is C-query coverage; FF is affected-free fraction. Neither is whole-mesh intersection volume.
closed_two_faces_per_edge is a descriptive coordinate-index condition, not full manifold/watertight/embedded-solid proof.
Existing actual nonblind AI_PROXY image reviews separate from objective fields.
boundary_distance fields are vertex-to-free-corner, not full edge/surface gap distribution.

required_work_for_comparison: Reaggregate all 135 fields with registered denominators, retain parent/noise pairs and tail cases, read independent edge/illegal-pair/movement ledgers and actual images; do not introduce new score definitions or replace NA with 0.
cache_check_caveat: Current pass verifies registered file hashes, cached statuses and scalar denominator/identity fields. Does not rerun finite-triangle classifier or reload/recheck all NPZ array content; independent original mesh/array audits already retained.
winding_interpretation: All 4624 original legal edges retained with original winding in each variant. New valid contact edges include 3/4 same-direction FF edges; graph_valid is not the same as winding-consistent graph. EXACT_COORD same-direction totals increase 209 to 212/213. No reorientation was executed by HINGE; do not infer global orientation preservation from zero old-edge loss.

original_runtime.scope: Original measured CPU whole HINGE+scoring dispatch duration including both thresholds, not a new timing benchmark or isolated runtime. Individual cell seconds unavailable unless explicitly present.

per_threshold_stats.interpretation: Recorded per-cell elapsed time includes decode/scoring; concurrent sums are not walltime or isolated compute benchmarks.
Recorded per-cell elapsed time includes decode/scoring; concurrent sums are not walltime or isolated compute benchmarks.
